description: (0.5.0) did:web snapshot selection at T and the observed vs pinned basis (RFC-ACDP-0017 §6.2, §6.3). The producer rotates from K1 to K2 after T; the body is signed by K1 and receipted before T.

did_documents.did:web:registry.example.com: one snapshot observed 2026-08-01T00:00:00.000Z with #receipt-key-1 in verificationMethod

expected.note: Rotation is not compromise (RFC-ACDP-0014 §9): no revoked_after_as_of; the verdict is ok_with_caveats in both passes, so no verdict_changed.

expected.behavior: Drop the 2026-09-20 snapshot. As of T: key unknown, reason no_evidence_at_as_of, the signature stage omitted (RFC-ACDP-0017 §7.4), node verdict unknown. Latest: historical_receipt_attested. Drift [as_of_unprovable] only — it explains the verdict change.
The caller pins the 2026-09-20 snapshot: as of T key rests on basis pinned, the observed_basis caveat is gone from as_of if nothing else is observed, and options_digest changes.

scenarios.name: D — pinned key that does not verify

expected.behavior: Pinning never overrides a failed check: a pinned snapshot whose key does not verify the signature gives signature: invalid → refused.

notes: Behavioral scenarios: the verifier builds the described bundle from real signed bodies, runs verify_chain, and asserts the stage values and verdicts. Test keys: the did:key producer is the sig-001 zero seed (did:key:z6MkiTBz…, not sig-003's 0x42 seed); did:web producer #key-1 is the zero seed and #key-2 is 0x02×32; registry did:web:registry.example.com #receipt-key-1 is 0x11×32. Every bundle whose receipts must verify carries a registry DID snapshot (REG_SNAP) and every producer carries a discovery record unless a scenario removes it. Where present, `vectors` are known answers: the bundle and verdict files plus their pinned digests, executed by scripts/conformance-runner.py (RFC-ACDP-0017 §14).
